title: Topic
description: A defined unique area of knowledge

id.description: Unique identifier for this topic within its topic list. Kebab case. Ex: 'my-topic-id'

display-name.description: Optional human-friendly name for this topic.

description.description: A brief explanation of the knowledge represented by this topic. Max 100 characters.

docs-url.description: HTTP(S) URL to a reference that explains this topic.

validity-period.description: The suggested validity period when assigning a score to this topic. Min 30 days. Default is 732 days (~2 years).

subtopics.description: List of topics that directly represent proficiency in a subspace of this topic.

pretopics.description: List of topics required as prerequisites before beginning to obtain proficiency in this topic.

items.description: Reference to a topic identifier or external topic (e.g., 'namespace.topic-id')
